palettePolicy: Fifteen fixed opaque RGB555 entries per identity selected from base artwork or explicit identity palette. All body families use that palette; a projectile may quantize to an explicitly recorded subset of its existing neutral entries.
packingPolicy: Only nearest-neighbor scale, pose translation, complete-component selection and fixed palette quantization. No redraw, synthetic poses, mirrored poses, or original-character replacements.

run.gaitDescription: Authored asymmetric Sans shuffle with alternating near/far support; not a canonical mirrored eight-phase human gait.

base.colorkeyPolicy: Only exact source background RGB connected to each rectangle boundary is made transparent; enclosed eye/highlight pixels are preserved.

motion.colorkeyPolicy: Only exact source background RGB connected to each rectangle boundary is made transparent; enclosed eye/highlight pixels are preserved.

rear.colorkeyPolicy: Only exact source background RGB connected to each rectangle boundary is made transparent; enclosed eye/highlight pixels are preserved.
